title: International Pathogen Surveillance Network (IPSN)
description: WHO-led global network, convened by the WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence, to advance pathogen genomic surveillance by harmonizing data standards, accelerating country capacity scale-up, coordinating funding, and fostering partnerships to improve public-health decision-making. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/initiatives/international-pathogen-surveillance-network))
keyFeatures: Vision: equitable access for every country to sustained sequencing and analytics capacity. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/initiatives/international-pathogen-surveillance-network))
Mission: a mutually supportive global network to improve access and equity. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/initiatives/international-pathogen-surveillance-network))

Communities of practice on genomics data to harmonize standards, ensure tools are fit for purpose, and enhance data and benefits sharing. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/initiatives/international-pathogen-surveillance-network))

Country Scale-Up Accelerator to build capacity and enable South–South exchange, producing capacity-building tools as global goods. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/initiatives/international-pathogen-surveillance-network))

Funders forum and small grants to coordinate donor efforts and power IPSN projects. ([who.int](https://www.who.int/initiatives/international-pathogen-surveillance-network)); One-slide overview summarizing scope and offerings.
